appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Theme, accent color, language and content sizing. Changes apply immediately and are remembered.

language.label: Language
language.hint: Interface language. "System" follows your operating system.

themeMode.label: Theme mode
themeMode.hint: Light, dark, or follow the system setting.

accent.label: Accent color
accent.hint: Used for buttons, links and highlights.

avatars.label: Contact avatars
avatars.hint: Off by default — enabling sends a one-way hash of each contact's email address to gravatar.com. Avatars are cached locally; turning this off hides them again.

profileMarkers.label: Profile color markers
profileMarkers.hint: Show a colored bar at the start of each thread in cross-account lists, colored by the account's profile or account color.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Accounts live on this machine; messages sync locally and work offline.
accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Add one to start syncing mail.

backfill.title: Download the older mail too?
backfill.description: The first-sync window for <email>{{email}}</email> widened ({{range}}). Messages that were skipped before can be fetched now — only the newly covered range is downloaded, online or at the next launch. Cancel to keep the wider window without downloading older mail.
backfill.queueFailed: Could not queue the download of older mail.

reading.title: Reading
reading.description: How the mailbox is laid out and when you are notified about new mail.

notifications.label: New-mail notifications
notifications.hint: Show a system notification when sync finds new messages. Unread badges are always kept up to date.

markReadOnOpen.label: Mark as read on open
markReadOnOpen.hint: Opening a message marks it read. Manual mark read/unread and rules always work as usual.

notifications.title: Notifications

newMailSound.label: New-mail sound
newMailSound.hint: Play a chime with new-mail notifications. Senders and threads that are silenced stay silent — no banner, no sound.

sentSound.label: Sent-message sound
sentSound.hint: Play a chime when a message is sent. Off for messages that are only queued while offline.

notifications.rulesNote: Rules apply when sync finds new mail. A "never" rule wins over an "always" rule when both match, and muted threads stay silent either way. Suppressed messages are still delivered and unread — including in the unread badge — so the badge can show mail you were not notified about.
notifications.noAccount: Add an account to manage its notification rules.
notifications.empty: No rules yet. New mail notifies as usual.

addDialog.title: Add Notification Rule
addDialog.description: Always or never show new-mail notifications for one sender or label of this account.
addDialog.saveFailed: Could not save the rule — an identical rule may already exist.

desktop.title: Desktop
desktop.description: How Emailer behaves in your operating system.

mailto.label: Default mail client
mailto.hint: Handle mailto: links from your browser and other apps in Emailer. Unsetting restores the previous default mail client.

autostart.label: Launch at login
autostart.hint: Start Emailer automatically when you log in, hidden in the tray — syncing and notifying from the start.

composeShortcut.label: Global compose shortcut
composeShortcut.registered: Registered — pressing it in any application surfaces Emailer with a fresh composer.
composeShortcut.none: No global shortcut registered. Use modifier prefixes like CmdOrCtrl+Shift+…

closeAction.label: When closing the window
closeAction.hideHint: Emailer keeps running in the system tray — mail keeps syncing and notifications keep arriving. Restore it from the tray icon.
closeAction.quitHint: Closing the window quits Emailer and stops background syncing.

desktop.noTray: Tray integration is not available on this platform; Emailer behaves as a regular windowed application.

updates.title: Updates
updates.runningBeta: You are running emailer v{{version}} on the beta channel.

channel.label: Release channel
channel.betaOption: Beta — prereleases as soon as they build
channel.hint: The channel decides which manifest update checks ask; switching takes effect on the next check.

updates.desktopOnly: Update checks are only available in the installed desktop app.
updates.available: Version {{version}} is available on the {{channel}} channel (you are on {{current}}).
updates.ready: Update installed — restart to apply it.
updates.downloadFailed: The update could not be downloaded.

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: What Emailer keeps on this device.
storage.approximate: Some files could not be read, so these sizes are a lower bound.
storage.loadFailed: Could not measure local storage. Check that the app was started from its desktop build and try again.

attachments.label: Attachments
attachments.description: Downloaded attachment copies, cached by hash

databases.label: Databases & indexes
databases.description: The local mail database — message bodies, AI cache, calendar and task data, contacts, preferences

keys.label: Sealed credentials
keys.description: The key file that seals account credentials on this device

deleteAll.title: Delete all local data
deleteAll.hint: Remove everything Emailer keeps on this device and start over. Your mail servers are not touched.

deleteFailed.title: Could not finish deleting local data
deleteFailed.description: Some local data may already be gone. Your mail servers are untouched — restart Emailer and try again.

deleteDialog.title: Delete all local data?
deleteDialog.description: This removes from THIS device, for every account:

items.mail: every account's local mail — message bodies and their read states
items.credentials: sealed credential slots — you will be signed out of every account

deleteDialog.serversNote: Your mail servers are not touched — every message stays on the server. After the reset Emailer restarts in its first-run state, and your mail syncs back down once you add your accounts again.
deleteDialog.confirmDescription: This cannot be undone. Everything listed will be removed from this device and Emailer will restart as if freshly installed. Your mail servers keep every message.

backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.description: Move your Emailer setup between machines with a single, checksummed archive file.

export.title: Export
export.hint: Writes your accounts' settings, profiles, rules, snippets, quick steps, signatures, saved searches, categories and a verified database snapshot — with synced mail — into one file. No passwords or tokens are ever included; each restored account signs in again.

restore.title: Restore
restore.hint: Restore a backup file. Every checksum is verified before anything changes, and a failed or cancelled restore leaves your current data intact.
restore.replaceDone_one: {{count}} account was restored. Sign in to each one to start syncing again — your restored mail is readable right now.
restore.replaceDone_other: {{count}} accounts were restored. Sign in to each one to start syncing again — your restored mail is readable right now.
restore.mergeNote: Message bodies are not part of a merge — each account downloads its mail again on first sync.

restoreDialog.title: Restore from backup
restoreDialog.replaceWarning: Replacing deletes everything Emailer keeps on this device first — every account, message body, setting, profile and rule — and restores the backup in its place. Accounts from the backup carry no passwords or tokens: you will sign in to each one again before it syncs or sends. Your mail servers are not touched.
restoreDialog.mergeWarning: Merging adds what your current setup is missing — accounts are matched by email address, and existing entries stay as they are. Message bodies are NOT restored by a merge: they sync fresh from the server on each account's first sync. Restored accounts sign in again before syncing.

errors.newerVersion: This backup was made by a newer version of Emailer (format v{{version}}). Update this app and try again.
errors.unreadableVersion: This file is not a readable Emailer backup (format v{{version}}).
errors.cancelledDetail: Restore cancelled — your existing data is unchanged.
errors.unreadable: This file is not a readable Emailer backup.
errors.unreadableDetail: It may be damaged, incomplete or tampered with. Your existing data was not touched.
errors.io: Emailer could not access that file.

dataPortability.title: Import & export
dataPortability.description: Take mailbox data out in standard formats, or bring archives back in. Exports never modify anything; imports never change existing messages.

export.title: Export folder as mbox
export.cancelled_one: Export cancelled — the partial file was removed ({{count}} message was written).
export.cancelled_other: Export cancelled — the partial file was removed ({{count}} messages were written).
export.hint: One RFC 4155 mbox per folder, importable by other mail clients. Exports are read-only. To export a single conversation, use “Export as EML” in the thread's context menu.

import.title: Import EML / mbox

upload.label: Also upload to the server
upload.hint: Appends each imported message to the account (IMAP folder or Gmail label). Offline, the import still completes locally and the skipped uploads are reported.

import.hint: Messages already present in the destination folder (same Message-ID) are skipped. Imported mail is marked read and never overwrites existing messages.

attachmentSecurity.title: Attachment security
attachmentSecurity.description: Known dangerous file types are always flagged and confirmed before they open. Optionally, attachments can also be checked against a malware lookup service before their first open.

lookup.label: Check attachments with a malware lookup
lookup.hint: Before an attachment opens for the first time, its SHA-256 hash is looked up. Malicious files are blocked with the detection report (you can still override); suspicious ones warn.

apiKey.label: VirusTotal API key
apiKey.placeholder: Paste your key (stored on this machine)
apiKey.hint: Only the file's SHA-256 hash is ever sent — attachment contents never leave this machine. Verdicts are cached locally per hash. Offline, without a key, or when the service cannot be reached, the built-in dangerous-file warnings above apply alone.

attachmentSecurity.alwaysOn: Executables, scripts, installers and macro-enabled Office documents are flagged by file type on every account, regardless of this setting.

voice.learned_one: Writing voice learned from {{count}} sent message.
voice.learned_other: Writing voice learned from {{count}} sent messages.

learnFailure.noSentMail: No sent messages were found to analyze.
learnFailure.notEnoughMail: Not enough sent mail yet — at least {{min}} sent messages are needed.
learnFailure.parse: The writing voice could not be read from the model's reply. Try again.

learnDisabled.noProvider: Connect and activate an AI provider first.
learnDisabled.notEnoughMail: Needs at least {{min}} sent messages to learn from.

dictation.label: Dictation
dictation.hint: The composer's mic turns speech into text entirely on this machine — a {{size}} speech model is downloaded once from Hugging Face and your voice is never uploaded.
dictation.downloadFailed: The model download failed ({{error}}). You can retry.
dictation.downloadCancelled: Download cancelled — dictation stays unavailable until the model is downloaded.

language.label: Dictation language
language.hint: Auto-detect lets the model recognize the spoken language; a fixed language pins transcription to it.

writing.title: Writing voice
writing.hint: Learn how you typically write from your recent sent messages (up to 30) with one AI call — voiced drafts, proofreads and smart replies then follow your voice. Learning runs only when you click, and nothing about the messages is stored — only the distilled style.
writing.noneWithSent_one: No writing voice learned yet — {{count}} sent message available.
writing.noneWithSent_other: No writing voice learned yet — {{count}} sent messages available.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Every keyboard binding. Press ? anytime for the quick reference.
shortcuts.conflict: {{action}} would collide with {{others}} — press another key or cancel.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Automatic inbox categories ({{names}}) shown as tabs above the thread list.

tabs.label: Category tabs
tabs.hint: Show the category tabs above the inbox, with unread counts per category. Your folders and split tabs are unaffected.

existing.label: Categorize existing mail
existing.hint: Classify messages already in your mailbox with the same local engine new mail uses. Already-categorized threads are left alone.
